title: The Impact of Fasting Duration on Quality of Recovery After Cesarean Section
official: How Fasting Duration Before Cesarean Section Affects the Quality of Recovery Score (ObsQoR-11)
summary: This study will evaluate the effect of fasting duration and elective c-section start time on the overall quality of recovery. Patients will be seen 24 hours after surgery to answer 11 questions on their overall recovery after surgery. Several factors will be tracked to determine their effect on recovery, with the primary variable of interesting
conditions: Fasting ( 6H for Solid ; 2H for Clear Fluid )
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Presenting for elective c-section under spinal anesthesia

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unable to communicate in French or English
* Urgent c-section
* Planned general anesthesia
